prompt: Declare a max-heap named `maxH` of Integers, using a PriorityQueue with a lambda (x, y) passed to the constructor that returns Integer.compare(y, x).
answer: PriorityQueue<Integer> maxH = new PriorityQueue<>((x, y) -> Integer.compare(y, x));
why: A lambda (x, y) -> Integer.compare(y, x) also makes a max-heap. Avoid y - x because it can overflow.
